label: Report-to-event premise: the commission reported in Matthew…, by Reliability of testimony of…
rule: Reliability of testimony of those present
meaning: Matthew 28.18-20 and John 21.15-17 rest on the testimony of those present, and such testimony is accurate; so both commissions go back to Jesus, and John 21's (shepherding) is one of the four governing reports. Two open premises; each is needed.
